note: Tonio's AI-generated content: concept images (*.jpeg, front views of characters, a helijet from four sides, a hexapod exoskeleton) and the meshes generated from them (*.glb, one mesh each, unrigged, about 1.9 units tall and centred on the origin, PBR colour, normal and metallic-roughness maps). The number in a mesh's name is its triangle count (10k = about 10,000). For tosijs-3d's auto-rigger and Dramatis's 'bring your hero' door. Released under CC0, overriding the tonio namespace's CC BY. The published meshes have their PNG textures re-encoded as JPEG (static-assets bin/glb-jpeg.ts, quality 88, 2048 px): about a third of the size, core glTF. source/ holds the files as generated, including the 2M-triangle meshes (about 70 MB each, too big for the CDN), and is not published. It also keeps medieval-peasant-soldier-manga-11k-meshy-rig.glb, the same mesh rigged by Meshy on a Mixamo skeleton with Meshy's animations: those are Meshy's 'Service Assets', licensed only as part of the model they came with, so they cannot be released as CC0 and the file is not published. weapons/ is Tonio's weapons library, work in progress: not published until he says it is ready.
